_doc: Input & window telemetry catalogue (P2.09). Docs/01 §5 is the trigger list, docs/05 §1.3 the meta events; `stage_min` is the docs/05 gate for when she may react (detection itself is ungated so the trigger engine can count it). `line` becomes this turn's docs/08 §6 EVENT line; `quote_line` is the docs/05 M21 stage-3 quote of a deleted draft — its {text} is memory-only (never persisted).

draft_deleted.line: EVENT: The player typed something and deleted it without sending it.
draft_deleted.quote_line: EVENT: The player typed this and deleted it without sending it: "{text}"

focus_lost.line: EVENT: The game window lost focus while you were talking. The player looked away.

close_requested.line: EVENT: The player tried to close the game.

idle.line: EVENT: The player has been silent for {seconds} seconds while you wait for an answer.

window_resized.line: EVENT: The player resized the game window.

screenshot.line: EVENT: The player took a screenshot of you.

message_repeated.line: EVENT: The player sent the same message again ({count} times in a row).
